build.buildCommand: pnpm install && sed -i 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' ../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma generate --schema=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma

deploy.startCommand: sed -i 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' ../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && sed -i 's/provider = "sqlite"/provider = "postgresql"/' ../../packages/db/prisma/migrations/migration_lock.toml || true; npx prisma generate --schema=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma && npx prisma db push --schema=../../packages/db/prisma/schema.prisma --accept-data-loss && npx tsx ../../packages/db/prisma/seed.ts || true; pnpm start
